1879097203.name: Cat-speech
1879097203.desc: Summons a little cat-friend to brighten your day.

1879112563.name: A Small Snag
1879112563.desc: Activated by Double-edged Strike, you attack an enemy below the belt, setting them off-balance and increasing the damage they take further if they already suffer from Reveal Weakness.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Chain Skills have a chance to grant you a Critical Response.
A Small Snag will spread Reveal Weakness to nearby enemies when used on a target already suffering from A Small Snag.

1879182835.name: True Heroics
1879182835.desc: Restores power and grants other bonuses based on your Trait Specialization.

1879191027.name: Stealth
1879191027.desc: The Rangers of the North have always been skilled at becoming unseen when they wish to be.

1879191795.name: Bannerguard
1879191795.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Bannerguard.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879198323.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Spotted Lynx)
1879198323.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879200627.name: Mandible Strike
1879200627.desc: Using its powerful mandibles, your hatchling delivers a devastating blow.

1879208435.name: White-clad Pony of the Gap
1879208435.desc: A pony bearing a horsehead emblem in white and gold barding.

1879214579.name: Impressive Flourish
1879214579.desc: Ready your weapon, increasing your ability to parry.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879221619.name: Seeds of Doubt
1879221619.desc: Gríma Wormtongue excels at planting seeds of doubt in the minds of others. There are some, such as his master Saruman, who are not susceptible to his whispers.

1879245811.name: Trample
1879245811.desc: Your steed is able to barrel over unmounted foes dealing massive damage.

1879248371.name: Noble Arrow - Fire
1879248371.desc: The Noble Arrow of Fire, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879250035.name: Driving Slash
1879250035.desc: Using a violent slash against the target you attempt to seriously injure your foe.

1879257971.name: Set Trap
1879257971.desc: Places a trap to root the enemy.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879263603.name: Lay Trap
1879263603.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Applies a 10s Fear effect to the first enemy who triggers the trap.</rgb>

1879274099.name: Snap Shot - Javelin of Deadly Force - Light
1879274099.desc: With preparation, some Wardens can throw their Javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.\n\nFor every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

1879329779.name: Steed of the Ithilien Winter
1879329779.desc: A pony from the Winter Festival.

1879385075.name: Herald of the Northern Star
1879385075.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879400051.name: Elk of Festive Spirit
1879400051.desc: An Elk steed perfect for winter celebrations.

1879414771.name: Get Serious
1879414771.desc: Regenerate Mettle and gain a damage buff

1879418739.name: Facepaint - Butterfly
1879418739.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a butterfly pattern.

1879463027.name: Cave Slug
1879463027.desc: Summons a cave slug to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467251.name: The North Wind
1879467251.desc: Call the North Wind down upon your foes.

conditionalEffects.description: Shanties will restore the morale of affected allies.
Calling to one of the winds will restore some of your morale.

1879470579.name: Anchored Thrust
1879470579.desc: Anchoring your feet into your stirrups, you make a powerful finishing strike.

1879480307.name: Muster at the Bloody Eagle Tavern
1879480307.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Bloody Eagle Tavern in Umbar Baharbêl.

1879491059.name: Moonstone Drakeling
1879491059.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879494131.name: Guise of Gandalf the White
1879494131.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Gandalf the White. Although you look the part, you ought to think twice before trying to tame one of the mearas!

1879496307.name: Cozy Shelter
1879496307.desc: Place down a small cozy shelter, ideal for long nights travelling Middle-earth.

1879497715.name: Major Pet Command
1879497715.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506547.name: Frost Sheath
1879506547.desc: Surround yourself in an icy shell, reducing incoming damage and slowing your attackers with the Gelid Wind.

1879528563.name: Gelid Wind Synergy
1879528563.desc: Devoted to the Gelid Wind, infused by a Synergy, your target emits ice shards, damaging nearby enemies and afflicting them with an effect corresponding to the devotion of your most recent attack.

1879528819.name: Prepared: Shadow-spike
1879528819.desc: Send a shadowy spike at your target, dealing damage and reducing their tactical prowess.
